title: The Borrowed Cipher
author: Rafael Brightwater
blurb: Coral Okonkwo, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
